title: Airport directory
statementMd:
List every airport's code, city and country.

Expected columns: `code`, `city`, `country`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT code, city, country FROM airports;
```
